recordContract.itemSha256: Canonical item hash from inventory (recursively sorted object keys)
recordContract.verdict: Exactly one permitted verdict after full individual review
recordContract.dimensions: Object keyed by all 13 dimension names, each {status, evidence}; evidence must describe this item and the reviewed content, not mere field existence
recordContract.distractors: Array of {optionId, status, misconception, evidence, explanationStatus, explanationEvidence}; cover every active wrong choice separately. Non-choice interactions use [] and review every alternative in interactionReview.
recordContract.interactionReview: Object explaining accepted response, partial/zero semantics, aliases/relations/axes as applicable; no hidden accepted values or prompt/scoring mismatch
recordContract.findings: Array of {code, dimensions, problem, evidence, remediation}; mandatory for non-PASS
recordContract.factChecks: Array of {url, checkedDate, claim, result, evidence}; current official sources for material certification claims, explicitly BLOCKED if not verifiable
recordContract.duplicatePeers: Exact item IDs compared with this item; inspect actual semantic differences, shared unit alone is not duplication
recordContract.reviewer: {model, reasoningEffort, method}; never claim exact snapshot or tokens/cost when unavailable

rules: Read each complete item including all constraints, options, answer, feedback and source refs before recording any verdict.
No batch verdict inheritance, generic generated PASS, regex-only verdict, representative sampling or field-presence approval.
Unreviewed inventory entries have no verdict. Missing review is never BLOCKED_FACT_CHECK.
A substantive known defect takes FIX_MAJOR/FIX_MINOR/REMOVE even if factual dimension is BLOCKED; factual uncertainties remain recorded.
PASS requires affirmative evidence for all applicable dimensions and current official fact checks where required.
This model audit grants no human editorial approval, activation or publication.
Keep content and runtime unchanged. Record remediation directions, never rewrite questions during audit.
